description: Submission of the Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No.11 of 2025 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The World Anti-Doping Agency updates the Prohibited Items List for athletes annually, and the ratified countries also enforce the said list in their countries in parallel. Accordingly, the Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No.11 of 2025 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2471/51 dated 2026-01-16 under the provisions of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013 in order to enforce the Prohibited List for the year 2026 in this Country. The proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
